name: osct
description: The Open Source Contribution Toolkit: skills for auditing a repo, filing issues, opening and reviewing pull requests, addressing review comments, and writing documentation.

plugins.name: osct
plugins.description: The whole Open Source Contribution Toolkit. Bundles the audit, issue, pull request, review, review-response and documentation skills.

plugins.name: osct-audit
plugins.description: Audit a repo for bugs, features and tasks and write them up as issue drafts under .osct/issue-ideas/, each bug carrying a repro that was actually run.

plugins.name: osct-docs
plugins.description: Write and edit documentation: a house writing style, per-project conventions kept in .osct/docs/, a change checklist, and a checker for examples, links and prose.

plugins.name: osct-open-issue
plugins.description: File a GitHub issue from the CLI: pick the template, keep the body short, set the type and the module label, and move the draft to the filed folder.

plugins.name: osct-open-pr
plugins.description: Open a pull request from the CLI: branch off main, write a one-paragraph body, link the issue, and fall back to the REST endpoint when gh pr edit fails.

plugins.name: osct-pr-review
plugins.description: Review a pull request into numbered, pasteable file:line comments with suggestion blocks, drafted to .osct/reviews/ for approval before anything is posted.

plugins.name: osct-address-pr-comments
plugins.description: Verify PR review comments against the issue, PR, code and checks; implement valid fixes and draft terse replies for approval before posting.
